title: Greek Anaphora
author: Epiphanius of Salamis
blurb: A 4th-century bishop's thanksgiving prayer over bread and wine, showing how early Christians worshipped.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Epiphanius of Salamis’s Anaphora Graeca — new OET from PG 41–43 Greek (Khazarzar). Modern English syncs (incl. Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill) were not used as wording. Melito skipped. Never Cyril Matthew densify. SERIES CLOSEOUT.
